fields.name: BeginSeqNo
fields.description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent

fields.name: BeginString
fields.description: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: BodyLength
fields.description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: CheckSum
fields.description: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing , as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: EndSeqNo
fields.description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo (7) = EndSeqNo. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = "0" (representing infinity).

fields.name: MsgSeqNum
fields.description: Integer message sequence number.

fields.name: MsgType
fields.description: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted) Note: A "U" as the first character in the MsgType field (i.e. U, U2, etc) indicates that the message format is privately defined between the sender and receiver. *** Note the use of lower case letters ***

fields.name: NewSeqNo
fields.description: New sequence number

fields.name: PossDupFlag
fields.description: The PossDupFlag is set to Y when resending a message as the result of a session level event (i.e. the retransmission of a message reusing a sequence number). The receiving application should process message with PossDupFlag = "Y" as follows: if a message with this sequence number has been previously received, ignore message, if not, process normally.

fields.name: RefSeqNum
fields.description: Reference message sequence number

fields.name: SenderCompID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

fields.name: SenderSubID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

fields.name: SendingTime
fields.description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: TargetCompID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

fields.name: TargetSubID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Free format text string (Note: this field does not have a specified maximum length)

fields.name: Signature
fields.description: Electronic signature

fields.name: SecureDataLen
fields.description: Length of encrypted message

fields.name: SecureData
fields.description: Actual encrypted data stream

fields.name: SignatureLength
fields.description: Number of bytes in signature field

fields.name: RawDataLength
fields.description: Number of bytes in raw data field.

fields.name: RawData
fields.description: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

fields.name: PossResend
fields.description: The PossResend is set to Y when reissuing a message with a new sequence number (i.e. when resending an order). The receiving application should process message with PossResend = "Y" as follows: forward message to application and determine if previously received (i.e. verify order id and parameters).

fields.name: EncryptMethod
fields.description: Method of encryption.

metadata.fix:values: {"0":"None / Other","1":"PKCS (Proprietary)","2":"DES (ECB Mode)","3":"PKCS / DES (Proprietary)","4":"PGP / DES (Defunct)","5":"PGP / DES-MD5 (See app note on FIX web site)","6":"PEM / DES-MD5 (see app note on FIX web site)"}

fields.name: HeartBtInt
fields.description: Heartbeat interval (seconds)

fields.name: TestReqID
fields.description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat

fields.name: OnBehalfOfCompID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

fields.name: OnBehalfOfSubID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: OrigSendingTime
fields.description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

fields.name: GapFillFlag
fields.description: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

metadata.fix:values: {"N":"Sequence Reset, Ignore Msg Seq Num (N/A For FIXML - Not Used)","Y":"Gap Fill Message, Msg Seq Num Field Valid"}

fields.name: DeliverToCompID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

fields.name: DeliverToSubID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

fields.name: ResetSeqNumFlag
fields.description: Indicates that the both sides of the FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

fields.name: SenderLocationID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: TargetLocationID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: OnBehalfOfLocationID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: DeliverToLocationID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: XmlDataLen
fields.description: Length of the XmlData data block.

fields.name: XmlData
fields.description: Actual XML data stream (e.g. FIXML). See approriate XML reference (e.g. FIXML). Note: may contain embedded SOH characters.

fields.name: MessageEncoding
fields.description: Type of message encoding (non-ASCII (non-English) characters) used in a message's "Encoded" fields.

fields.name: EncodedTextLen
fields.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedText (355) field.

fields.name: EncodedText
fields.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the Text (58) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the Text field.

fields.name: LastMsgSeqNumProcessed
fields.description: The last MsgSeqNum (34) value received by the FIX engine and processed by downstream application, such as trading engine or order routing system. Can be specified on every message sent. Useful for detecting a backlog with a counterparty.

fields.name: RefTagID
fields.description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

fields.name: RefMsgType
fields.description: The MsgType (35) of the FIX message being referenced.

fields.name: SessionRejectReason
fields.description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

metadata.fix:values: {"0":"Invalid Tag Number","1":"Required Tag Missing","2":"Tag not defined for this message type","3":"Undefined tag","4":"Tag specified without a value","5":"Value is incorrect (out of range) for this tag","6":"Incorrect data format for value","7":"Decryption problem","8":"Signature problem","9":"CompID problem","10":"SendingTime <52> accuracy problem","11":"Invalid MsgType <35>","12":"XML Validation Error","13":"Tag appears more than once","14":"Tag specified out of required order","15":"Repeating group fields out of order","16":"Incorrect NumInGroup count for repeating group","17":"Non \"Data\" value includes field delimiter (<SOH> character)","18":"Invalid/Unsupported Application Version","99":"Other"}

fields.name: MaxMessageSize
fields.description: Maximum number of bytes supported for a single message.

fields.name: NoMsgTypes
fields.description: Number of MsgTypes (35) in repeating group.

fields.name: MsgDirection
fields.description: Specifies the direction of the messsage.

fields.name: TestMessageIndicator
fields.description: Indicates whether or not this FIX Session is a "test" vs. "production" connection. Useful for preventing "accidents".

fields.name: Username
fields.description: Userid or username.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: Password or passphrase.

fields.name: NoHops
fields.description: Number of HopCompID entries in repeating group.

fields.name: HopCompID
fields.description: Assigned value used to identify the third party firm which delivered a specific message either from the firm which originated the message or from another third party (if multiple "hops" are performed). It is recommended that this value be the SenderCompID(49) of the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

fields.name: HopSendingTime
fields.description: Time that HopCompID(628) sent the message. It is recommended that this value be the SendingTime(52) of the message sent by the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

fields.name: HopRefID
fields.description: Reference identifier assigned by HopCompID(628) associated with the message sent. It is recommended that this value be the MsgSeqNum(34) of the message sent by the third party. Applicable when messages are communicated/re-distributed via third parties which function as service bureaus or "hubs". Only applicable if OnBehalfOfCompID(115) is being used.

fields.name: NextExpectedMsgSeqNum
fields.description: Next expected MsgSeqNum value to be received.

fields.name: NewPassword
fields.description: New Password or passphrase

fields.name: ApplVerID
fields.description: Specifies the service pack release being applied at message level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release

fields.name: CstmApplVerID
fields.description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the message level. Enumerated field.

fields.name: RefApplVerID
fields.description: Specifies the service pack release being applied to a message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID.

fields.name: RefCstmApplVerID
fields.description: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the session level.

fields.name: DefaultApplVerID
fields.description: Specifies the service pack release being applied, by default, to message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID.

fields.name: ApplExtID
fields.description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

fields.name: EncryptedPasswordMethod
fields.description: Enumeration defining the encryption method used to encrypt password fields. At this time there are no encryption methods defined by FPL.

fields.name: EncryptedPasswordLen
fields.description: Length of the EncryptedPassword(1402) field.

fields.name: EncryptedPassword
fields.description: Encrypted password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

fields.name: EncryptedNewPasswordLen
fields.description: Length of the EncryptedNewPassword(1404) field.

fields.name: EncryptedNewPassword
fields.description: Encrypted new password - encrypted via the method specified in the field EncryptedPasswordMethod(1400)

fields.name: RefApplExtID
fields.description: The extension pack number associated with an application message.

fields.name: DefaultApplExtID
fields.description: The extension pack number that is the default for a FIX session.

fields.name: DefaultCstmApplVerID
fields.description: The default custom application version ID that is the default for a session.

fields.name: SessionStatus
fields.description: Status of a FIX session

metadata.fix:values: {"0":"Session active","1":"Session password changed","2":"Session password due to expire","3":"New session password does not comply with policy","4":"Session logout complete","5":"Invalid username or password","6":"Account locked","7":"Logons are not allowed at this time","8":"Password expired"}
